predictions.rationale: Defines the CatalogItem entity representing products, including name, brand, type, picture URI, price, and stock quantities – core data model for managing items in the storefront.
Exposes REST endpoints for querying and manipulating catalog items, brands, types, and pictures; central API entry point for product management.
EF Core DbContext containing DbSets for CatalogItem, CatalogBrand, CatalogType and picture configurations; manages persistence of product information and stock.
Client-side service used by the MVC storefront to retrieve catalog items, brands, types, and pictures from the catalog API; bridges UI and product data.
Seeds initial catalog data (items, brands, types, pictures, stock) into the database, ensuring the storefront has product information.
Provides gRPC operations for retrieving catalog item details and stock, supporting alternative clients for product management.
Web MVC controller that orchestrates UI actions related to catalog browsing, item detail display, and pagination in the storefront.
Configures database schema for CatalogItem, including picture filename and stock properties; essential for correct storage of product data.
Provides helper extension methods for manipulating CatalogItem instances, such as updating picture URLs, supporting product picture management.
View model used to present pages of catalog items, brands, and types to clients, aligning with storefront display requirements.
